context: A couple shops a homewares sale, discussing décor and lighting
purpose: Teach: 壊れ/絵画/電池/セール/雑貨/照明/バッグ/真似

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ見て、この雑貨屋さん、今日からセール期間なんだって。
lines.en: Hey look, this homewares shop's sale starts today.
lines.style: Excited discovery, voice rises with genuine bargain-hunting enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 本当だ。あ、玄関の照明、ちょうど壊れてたよな。買い替えようか。
lines.en: Really. Oh, the entryway light was broken, right? Let's replace it.
lines.style: Calm, practical husband tone, thinking out loud while walking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。間接照明にしたら部屋の雰囲気変わると思うのよね。
lines.en: Yeah. I think indirect lighting would totally change the room's mood.
lines.style: Dreamy, slightly persuasive, imagining the new look at home.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: また雑誌の真似してるだろ。あの北欧スタイルの。
lines.en: You're copying that magazine again, aren't you? The Scandinavian one.
lines.style: Teasing, affectionate husband poking fun gently at his wife.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ちょっと、真似じゃなくて参考にしてるの。あ、この絵画もいいじゃない。
lines.en: Hey, it's not copying, it's inspiration. Oh, this painting's nice too.
lines.style: Mock-offended, then immediately distracted by a new shiny find.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 絵画はもう壁に余裕ないって。それより、時計の電池切れも買っとこう。
lines.en: No wall space left for paintings. More importantly, grab clock batteries.
lines.style: Pragmatic redirection, mildly exasperated dad keeping the budget grounded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: はいはい、乾電池ね。あ、このバッグも半額！
lines.en: Yes yes, dry-cell batteries. Oh, this bag is half off too!
lines.style: Dismissive then re-energized, classic shopping-mode mom voice.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ハンドバッグはこの前買ったばっかりじゃないか…まあ、君が決めなさい。
lines.en: You just bought a handbag recently... well, you decide.
lines.style: Resigned, gently surrendering with warm long-married patience.
